state.paragraph: On October 1, 2013, representatives of Mac-Gray management, along with representatives from BofA Merrill Lynch and representatives from CSC/Pamplona attended a meeting at the Boston offices of Goodwin Procter for purposes of conducting confirmatory business due diligence. Representatives of Mac-Gray, Goodwin Procter, BofA Merrill Lynch and representatives of CSC/Pamplona and Kirkland participated in various telephone conference calls over the subsequent days to finalize business and legal due diligence.

ledger_rows.Note: Executed with CSC and Pamplona until 5 p.m. ET 10/12/2013; included $15M CSC reverse termination fee and no financing contingency; Pamplona funding 100%.
After Moab and Pamplona held rollover discussions, the Special Committee was told Moab would not roll over any shares in the transaction.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
